Method of Attack: Used OAuth apps created using compromised accounts to maintain persistence and launch phishing campaigns using an adversary-in-the-middle (AiTM) phishing kit
Attack Vector: Compromised user accounts lacking multi-factor authentication
Creation of multitenant OAuth apps for persistence and phishing
Indicators of Compromise: Around 17,000 multitenant OAuth applications created across different tenants
More than 927,000 phishing emails sent via malicious OAuth applications
Use of Microsoft Outlook Web Application (OWA) for BEC reconnaissance
